## Summary

Describe the user-visible or implementation change and why it belongs in Castle.

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test`
- [ ] Relevant Castle workflow exercised manually when applicable

## Compatibility

Note any effect on command behavior, `castle.toml`, generated files, terminal output, supported platforms, or toolchain requirements. Write `None` when there is no compatibility impact.
